args.body: Read l369-mission-evidence.json if committed and follow the original mission's evidence references before any further archive search. A reproducible source bundle may establish package identity if it matches the historical receipt. Verify the exact payload and member grants before preparing the private listing. If the original evidence cannot establish them, save a bounded verdict naming the exact missing receipt, file or grant and what would reopen the route. Read back the result and close under a valid lease with a lesson. Keep activation, sale, payout and Treasury settlement separate.

description: Treasury shows CAD 0 available and no verified revenue. Commercial feedback shows zero classified events and five unclassified sources, so buyer demand remains unknown. The latest SQLite search found no archive candidates within its selected inputs. L369 records a successful learner run, so the next step is to trace that run through the original mission evidence and identify the exact paid package or the specific evidence needed to recover it. The catalogue release can proceed independently when the host records eligible approval for its staged digest.
